_note: Rule bank for the Spell->Sound series (docs/specs/spell-sound.md, template `rule`). Hand-written ONCE; every word is mined by `gen.py --rules` from the audited word bank (spelling match + IPA check + CEFR/NGSL order, top 6) into rules-words.json - never hand-edited, never an IPA override. pattern = regex on the lowercase spelling, group (?P<s>..) = the silent letters shown struck through. ipa_re / ipa_absent = regexes on the US IPA (stress marks stripped) that PROVE the rule (a word whose IPA does not show it is dropped). target = the sound the learner should say instead of the letter-by-letter reading; wrong = the typical letter-by-letter reading used by the hook. Tests: scripts/test/teach2d-rules.py.

rules.title: kn-
rules.say: In k n, the K is silent. Say N.

rules.title: wr-
rules.say: In w r, the W is silent. Say R.

rules.title: gn
rules.say: In g n, the G is silent. Say N.

rules.title: -mb
rules.say: At the end, m b, the B is silent. Say M.

rules.title: ps-
rules.say: At the start, p s, the P is silent. Say S.

rules.title: -ght
rules.say: In g h t, the G H is silent. Say T.

rules.title: silent h
rules.say: Here the H is silent. Start with the next sound.

rules.title: -alk / -alm
rules.say: In a l k and a l m, the L is silent.

rules.title: -bt
rules.say: Before t, the B is silent. Say T.

rules.title: -stle / -sten
rules.say: In s t l e and s t e n, the T is silent.

rules.title: -igh
rules.say: In i g h, the G H is silent. Say eye.

rules.title: -eigh-
rules.say: In e i g h, the G H is silent. Say A.

rules.title: -ough
rules.say: In o u g h, the G H can be silent. Do not say it.

rules.title: wh-
rules.say: In w h o, the W is silent. Say H.

rules.title: -mn
rules.say: At the end, m n, the N is silent. Say M.

rules.title: sc-
rules.say: In s c e, the C is silent. Say S.

rules.title: gu-
rules.say: In g u, the U is silent. Say G.

rules.title: exh-
rules.say: In e x h, the H is silent. Say Z.

rules.title: rh-
rules.say: In r h, the H is silent. Say R.

rules.title: -ould
rules.say: In o u l d, the L is silent.

rules.title: ch = k
rules.say: Here c h says K. The H is silent.

rules.title: -gue
rules.say: At the end, g u e, the U E is silent.

rules.title: -que
rules.say: At the end, q u e, the U E is silent. Say K.

rules.title: -e
rules.say: At the end, the E is silent.

rules.title: isl-
rules.say: In i s l, the S is silent.

rules.title: -ver- / -fer-
rules.say: In v e r, the E is often silent.

rules.title: -ically
rules.say: In i c a l l y, the A is silent. Say KLEE.

rules.title: -ely
rules.say: In e l y, the E is silent.

rules.title: -ement
rules.say: In e m e n t, the first E is silent.

rules.title: -ng
rules.say: At the end, n g is one sound. Do not say G.
